name: Deliver to MacKinley
summary: At Steamwheedle Port, Stoley gives you bilge rum for MacKinley in Booty Bay. The Sea Wolf can judge whether the drink settles his beliefs about Booty Bay booze.

sections.title: A Bottle to Carry
sections.body: After you help with the shipment, Stoley gives you a bottle of Steamwheedle bilge rum. You carry it to MacKinley in Booty Bay, where he can finally set aside his beliefs about the booze there.

sections.title: MacKinley's Verdict
sections.body: MacKinley tastes the rum and delights in its awfulness. Stoley kept his word about the bilge rum, so MacKinley need not pay the money he owes. He calls it thick as gravel and burning like lava.

faq.answer: Stoley gives you the bottle at Steamwheedle Port.

faq.q: Who receives the bottle of rum?
aliases: where do i take the bottle
faq.answer: The bottle goes to “Sea Wolf” MacKinley in Booty Bay.

faq.q: What kind of alcohol is being delivered?
faq.answer: A bottle of Steamwheedle bilge rum.

faq.q: Where does this step fit in the chain?
aliases: what comes before deliver to mackinley
faq.answer: This follows Stoley's Debt and Stoley's Shipment.
